@cc ===========================================================================
@cc CHATRT:MODE - RT-load the chat server from the four files on the install
@cc floppy, once they have been copied to (SYSTEM).
@cc
@cc   @MODE CHATRT:MODE,,
@cc
@cc It is the same step list tools\rt-load.ps1 types from Windows. THREE THINGS
@cc TO SET BEFORE RUNNING IT - edit this file:
@cc
@cc   2529      the segment number, in NEW-SEGMENT, every LOAD, and the
@cc             CHANGE-RT-DESCRIPTION answer. It must be FREE: NEW-SEGMENT
@cc             allocates a free segment and never reopens one. RELEASE-SEGMENT
@cc             first frees the number a previous server sat on.
@cc   FJELL     what this machine calls itself (SET-NAME)
@cc   102, 103  the system numbers of the peers to trunk to (START-TRUNK)
@cc
@cc The server must NOT be running when this runs. CHANGE-RT-DESCRIPTION refuses
@cc to touch a running program, says so once, and everything after still reports
@cc success - so ABORT comes first.
@cc
@cc CHANGE-RT-DESCRIPTION prompts in this order: RT-PROGRAM, PRIORITY, SEGMENT
@cc ONE, SEGMENT TWO, START ADDRESS, RING, INITIAL PAGE TABLE, ALTERNATIVE PAGE
@cc TABLE. START ADDRESS is left BLANK - a ring number typed there starts the
@cc program inside its own data and it dies with STACK OVERFLOW.
@cc
@cc NOT YET RUN AS A MODE FILE. The step list is proved (rt-load.ps1 has typed
@cc it many times); driving the RT-LOADER from a MODE file has not been tried.
@cc If it hangs, type the same lines by hand.
@cc ===========================================================================
@ABORT CHATSER
@RT-LOADER
RELEASE-SEGMENT 2529
NEW-SEGMENT 2529,2,,,
LOAD CHATSV,2529,
Y
LOAD CHATLIB,2529,
LOAD XMP-100-1-B02,2529,
LOAD MON-CALL-1B-A00,2529,
LOAD PLANC-1BANK-F00,2529,
END-LOAD
CHANGE-RT-DESCRIPTION
CHATSER
75
2529



2


EXIT-LOADER
@RT CHATSER
@LIST-RT-DESCRIPTION CHATSER
@CHAT-MON
SET-NAME FJELL
START-TRUNK 102
START-TRUNK 103
LIST-TRUNKS
EXIT
@cc CHATSER should show IN TIME QUEUE above, and LIST-TRUNKS the two peers.
